notes:
Lead source: inbound from integration docs page — trying to replace local LLM + webhooks. Background: small CX automation startup (11-50 engs), building a micro-SaaS that adds summarization and triage layer on top of Zendesk. Interested in Hosted API for rapid self-serve onboarding.

Key ask: reliable JSON/structured outputs for ticket triage + tool calling to create/update Zendesk tickets. They want function-calling like flow: summarize thread -> extract intent + priority -> call createTicket({fields}) via Redwood tooling.

Performance/scale: low QPS today but spikes during batch imports — expect up to ~50 req/s during imports; typical latency target: P95 <700ms for chat/summaries (low-cost model acceptable for bulk). Cost sensitivity: high — SMB budget, wants clear per-ticket cost estimate.

Model preferences: prefer open/quantized models (Llama2-family or Redwood-verified small models). Willing to try Redwood-hosted variants. Routing: prefer NA region, fallback to smaller quantized model if latency/cost thresholds breached.

Security/compliance: requires SOC2 evidence, SSO/SAML for team portal, audit logging and KMS support for encryption-at-rest. Data residency: US-only preference for now.

POC ask: 2-week technical POC — validate summarization quality vs current heuristic rules and validate function-calling integration to Zendesk (mapping to custom fields). Success metrics: >20% reduction in agent time on triage, summaries score >= 4/5 in internal eval, no PII leakage in summaries.

Notes from call: "We want a drop-in hosted API — minimal infra ops, but need predictable pricing for scaling." — Product lead.
